target_metric: Original query entry to final answer completion; seconds per query.

methodology.PARTIAL_COMPONENT_SUM: Sum available successful-call latency, dense batch_seconds/batch_queries, sparse total_ms/1000 and rerank_seconds by query, then average final-answer queries with timing. Unobserved stages are marked missing, not asserted zero.
methodology.MEASURED_STAGES_SUM: P02 selected successful local actual_seconds plus that query remote elapsed_seconds; a reconstruction from measured stages, not one continuous timer.
methodology.NO_FORMAL_RESULT: No current-version formal final-answer result; no timing substitution from old version/development.
methodology.NO_TIMING: A formal result exists but no usable timing was found.
methodology.denominator: Final answer produced, regardless of answer correctness. Algorithm failures, infrastructure failures and unstarted queries remain separate.

Earlier failed attempts are retained but not added to the selected-success mean.

limitations: None of the partial or staged reconstructions is a fully comparable controlled end-to-end latency benchmark.
Original and repaired version results are kept separate; native Iter T2/T3 is not substituted for matched50 T5.
Live databases are individually read under consistent read-only snapshots; cross-method snapshot times can differ.
Timing from caches retains its actual measured provenance; replay is not presented as fresh inference.
